integrity: Original proof via explicit harmonic decomposition; all computed determinant tests use package-local standard-library Python. Forcing-set classification is prior-covered, not new. No independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: All-parameter spectral factorization is for r>=3 equal peripheral clique sizes m>=2, combinatorial Laplacian of minimum ordinary zero-forcing exchange graph; arbitrary unequal sizes, other Laplacians, and mixing-time analyses are not claimed. Finite determinant checks are supporting only. Priority risk: unindexed matroid-exchange spectral results.
title: Laplacian spectrum and spanning-tree complexity of zero-forcing reconfiguration graphs of uniform clique bouquets
